name: Shape match cut (film editing)

source.description: Film editing convention: cut between two shots on a matching shape or position so the eye carries across. Since 2026-10-30 also informed by two inspected user-supplied references (figure-ground colour swap on a held shape; a dot that keeps its position across cuts).

technique: The incoming element starts at the outgoing element's position and scale, then settles. Variant seen in the corpus: hold the shape exactly in place and swap figure and ground colours on the cut.
licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.

provenance.observed: A blue dot on cream cuts to a cream dot on blue at the same position; later a square holds its place while the background changes.
The accent dot keeps its screen position across two hard cuts while the scene around it changes.
